title: Extend OnBeforeCheckBankAcc to skip specific bank reversal checks
summary: The OnBeforeCheckBankAcc event in the Reversal Entry table gains two Boolean parameters that let extensions skip the Open and Statement No. validations independently when reversing bank account ledger entries.
key_points: Two Boolean parameters appended to the OnBeforeCheckBankAcc event in the Reversal Entry table
Extensions can skip the Open check or the Statement No. check independently while other reversal checks still run
Existing subscribers stay compatible because the new parameters are trailing
Publisher updated in the W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FR, IT and RU layers
Tests added in W1, ES and SE for skipping each check during bank entry reversal
quote: This change lets extensions independently skip the Open and Statement No. validations when reversing a bank account ledger entry.
